description: Source code for the RpcAgent class and related components in PyTorch's distributed RPC framework, including registration, worker info management, RPC retry logic, and thread management.

classes.name: RegisterWorkerInfoOnce
classes.description: Helper class to register WorkerInfo class exactly once.

classes.name: WorkerInfo
classes.description: Represents information about a worker in the RPC framework, including name and ID.

classes.name: RpcAgent
classes.description: Manages RPC communication, retries, thread lifecycle, and worker info in PyTorch distributed RPC.

methods.name: RegisterWorkerInfoOnce
methods.description: Constructor that registers WorkerInfo class once.

methods.name: WorkerInfo
methods.description: Constructors for WorkerInfo with validation of name and ID.

methods.name: RpcAgent
methods.description: Constructor initializing RPC agent with worker info, callback, and timeout.

methods.name: ~RpcAgent
methods.description: Destructor that shuts down the RPC agent if running.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the RPC agent and its retry thread.

methods.name: shutdown
methods.description: Shuts down the RPC agent, joins thread, and calls shutdown implementation.

methods.name: sendWithRetries
methods.description: Sends a message with retry logic, returning a future.

methods.name: retryExpiredRpcs
methods.description: Thread function to retry expired RPCs based on timing.

methods.name: rpcRetryCallback
methods.description: Callback invoked after an RPC attempt to handle success or schedule retries.

methods.name: getWorkerInfo
methods.description: Returns the worker info associated with this RPC agent.

methods.name: isCurrentRpcAgentSet
methods.description: Checks if the current RPC agent is set.

methods.name: getCurrentRpcAgent
methods.description: Returns the current RPC agent, throws if not set.

methods.name: setCurrentRpcAgent
methods.description: Sets the current RPC agent, ensuring only one is set at a time.

methods.name: setTypeResolver
methods.description: Sets the type resolver for the RPC agent.

methods.name: getTypeResolver
methods.description: Gets the type resolver, asserts if not set.

methods.name: enableGILProfiling
methods.description: Enables or disables GIL profiling.

methods.name: isGILProfilingEnabled
methods.description: Checks if GIL profiling is enabled.

methods.name: getDeviceMap
methods.description: Returns device map; default is empty.

methods.name: getDevices
methods.description: Returns devices; default is CPU-only.

methods.name: getDebugInfo
methods.description: Returns debug info, defaulting to metrics.
